missing_evidence.cia_impact: No measured product crash, corruption, disclosure or privilege effect.
missing_evidence.entry_or_privilege_boundary: Source-visible SoftBus device and remote-command paths; privilege, trust boundary and attacker control unknown.
missing_evidence.publication_order_or_happens_before: GetOrCreateRemoteCommandExecutor publishes the executor; NotifyDeviceOnline checks GetChannel and calls SetChannel under RemoteCommandManager::mutex_. CreateChannelIfNeeded writes ptrChannel_ under RemoteCommandExecutor::recursive_mutex_; ProcessOneCommand/ExecuteRemoteCommand read it. Different locks leave no proven happens-before edge.
missing_evidence.thread_or_event_queue: Send command work is posted to TokenSyncManagerService::GetSendEventHandler() on an FFRT EventRunner; device online/offline enters through SoftBus device callbacks and socket session callbacks. Exact callback thread identities and common serialization are not proven.
missing_evidence.trigger_conditions_and_race_window: Device-online channel creation versus send-runner processing or socket callback use, with offline release/remove as a third event. Feasible product schedule and rate are not established.

missing_evidence.cia_impact: Controlled TSan proves owner data race/UB in the modeled component shape. Product crash/DoS, returned-entry integrity, confidentiality and privilege effects unmeasured.
missing_evidence.entry_or_privilege_boundary: Source-visible distributedKVStore NAPI entries; runtime permission, package resolution, app identity, cross-app/remote reachability and attacker control partial/unknown.
missing_evidence.publication_order_or_happens_before: GetResultSet execute calls SetInstance; completion returns the wrapper. Sync methods copy GetInstance. CloseResultSet execute calls GetInstance then SetInstance(nullptr). Completion serialization does not order execute against a later sync JS call.
missing_evidence.thread_or_event_queue: Sync ResultSet methods use GetCbInfoSync on the NAPI/JS call context. GetResultSet/CloseResultSet use NapiQueue::AsyncWork: execute runs on the NAPI worker pool and complete on the JS/NAPI queue. The same JSProxy owner can be read by a sync call while async CloseResultSet clears it.
missing_evidence.trigger_conditions_and_race_window: Source-visible sequence getResultSet -> closeResultSet -> immediate getEntry/getCount before async close execute completes. The controlled Harness models this exact overlap.

missing_evidence.publication_order_or_happens_before: Start copies main XComponentController from PipOption; reuse can replace it. SetXComponentController writes pipXComponentController_ and attaches it; ResetExtController detaches on stop. Source-rect/reset readers use the same members.

missing_evidence.trigger_conditions_and_race_window: Concurrent Start/Update/Stop/SetX while main and PIP windows share a controller. No controlled product interleaving or runner trace.

missing_evidence.cia_impact: No product trigger or CIA consequence established.
missing_evidence.entry_or_privilege_boundary: Stream setup/receive source-visible; product caller, privilege, attacker control and deployment unknown.
missing_evidence.publication_order_or_happens_before: Constructor initializes streamListener_. Create*Channel calls SetStreamRecvListener(streamListener_), which writes it, creates StreamSocketListener(recvListener) and installs the separate copy on the socket.
missing_evidence.thread_or_event_queue: Stream setup runs on caller thread. VtpStreamSocket creates detached NotifyStreamListener/DoStreamRecv threads and invokes streamReceiver_ under streamSocketLock_. streamListener_ itself is not shown to be read by callbacks; StreamSocketListener keeps a separate listener_ copy.
missing_evidence.trigger_conditions_and_race_window: Would require product caller to invoke public SetStreamRecvListener concurrently with Create*Channel or another setter. Production call-site search found setup calls and tests only.

missing_evidence.cia_impact: No CIA claim for unrelated sites; pixelMap safe only for owner race; HDR unknown.
missing_evidence.entry_or_privilege_boundary: Not promoted from lexical sites; surface behavior remains component-level.
missing_evidence.publication_order_or_happens_before: Out-of-lock reset can precede FutureCall; timeout GetHDRResult may read/copy the owner.
missing_evidence.thread_or_event_queue: HDR/error callbacks and GetHDRResult can differ; most accesses use Future::mutex_, but OnSurfaceCapture resets hdrPixelMap_=nullptr before FutureCall locks.
missing_evidence.trigger_conditions_and_race_window: Potential timeout/reset overlap; exact callback schedule and product trigger unproven.
